title: Custom Soccer Net with Number 07 Comforter Set, Machine Washable - A7
description:
Embrace the thrill of the game with our Jeminise Soccer Comforter Set, designed for young soccer enthusiasts. This bedding set transforms any boys' room into a haven for aspiring soccer stars, inspiring dreams and celebrating their passion for the sport.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young fans, this set ignites their love for soccer and inspires them to chase their dreams.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading, ensuring lasting color and quality.
  • Smooth Stitching: Edges of the blanket feature smooth, fine, and compact stitching for durability.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat.
  • Material Details: Made from polycotton, providing a quick-drying and fluffy feel.
